sql.value: INSERT INTO fxy_financial_tax_table ( tax_id, account_sets_id, company_name, tax_type, tax_state, tax_end_time, flag ) VALUES ( :taxId, :accountSetsId, :companyName, :taxType, :taxState, :taxEndTime, :flag );

select distinct t.id as accountSetsId, t.account_standard as accountStandard, t.vat_type as vatType, t.company_name as companyName, t.create_date as createDate, t.creator_id as creatorId, t.credit_code as creditCode, t.enable_date as enableDate, t.current_account_date, t.electricity_tax_code as electricityTaxCode, t.province as province, p.tax_id as taxId, p.tax_end_time as taxEndTime, p.tax_state as taxState, p.tax_type as taxType, d.id as localCurrencyId, trr.img_url as imageUrl, l.total_taxes as totalTaxes, l.tax_payment_html as taxPaymentHtml, l.img_url as paymentUrl, ttt.img_url as taxImageUrl, selfInspection.problem_description as problemDescription, selfInspection.img_url as selfInspectionImgUrl from fxy_financial_account_sets t left join fxy_financial_user_account_sets b on t.id = b.account_sets_id left join fxy_financial_tax_table p on t.id = p.account_sets_id left join fxy_financial_currency d on t.id = d.account_sets_id left join (select * from fxy_financial_timed_task_declare_self_inspection tr where tr.period = :currentDate) as selfInspection on t.id = selfInspection.account_sets_id left join (select ffttp.* from fxy_financial_timed_task_payment ffttp inner join ( select max(id) as id,account_sets_id from fxy_financial_timed_task_payment where DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m' ) = #[:accountPeriod] group by account_sets_id, check_date ) max_id_payment on max_id_payment.id = ffttp.id) l on t.id = l.account_sets_id left join (select ffttt.* from fxy_financial_timed_task_tax ffttt inner join ( select max(id) as id,account_sets_id from fxy_financial_timed_task_tax where DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m' ) = #[:accountPeriod] group by account_sets_id ,check_date , tax_type ) max_id_tax on max_id_tax.id = ffttt.id) ttt on ttt.account_sets_id = p.account_sets_id and p.tax_type = ttt.tax_type left join (select ffttti.* from fxy_financial_timed_task_tax_item ffttti inner join ( select max(id) as id,account_sets_id from fxy_financial_timed_task_tax_item where DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m' ) = #[:accountPeriod] group by account_sets_id, check_date ) max_id_item on max_id_item.id = ffttti.id ) trr on trr.account_sets_id = t.id where 1 = 1 and t.deactivated = 0
#[AND b.user_id = :userId] #[AND t.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :companyName,'%')] #[AND t.province = :province] order by t.id

SELECT COUNT(account_sets_id) AS invoiceCount FROM fxy_financial_invoice WHERE account_sets_id = :accountSetsId AND type = 1 AND trade_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND new_category IN ( "数电发票（二手车销售统一发票）", "数电纸质发票（二手车销售统一发票）", "二手车销售统一发票")
INSERT INTO financial.fxy_financial_tax_task_log ( id, user_id, account_sets_id, state, tax_type, company_name, tax_id ) VALUES (:id, :userId, :accountSetsId, 0, :taxType, :companyName, :taxId);
INSERT INTO financial.fxy_financial_tax_report_result ( account_set_id, tax_time, all_count, success_count, img_path, id ) VALUES (:accountSetId, :taxTime, :allCount, :successCount, :imgPath, :id);
INSERT INTO fxy_financial_image_payment ( account_sets_id, id, image_url ) VALUES (:accountSetsId, :id, :imageUrl);
